response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_of_group_avg_rental_rate, AVG(film_count) AS avg_of_group_film_count FROM (SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY original_language_id) AS g

assumptions.assumption: Films with NULL original_language_id form a single group, which GROUP BY on original_language_id does naturally (NULLs group together), so no COALESCE is needed.
Film count per group is COUNT(*) of films in the group (film_id is the primary key, so every row is a distinct film).
Each group is weighted equally in the outer averages (unweighted mean of the group-level figures), as the request states.
